_about: Item effects (user's choice: each item's own effect AND its icon pops over the holder). When an item goes off (a proc event with its itemId) the item's icon pops over the holder; `effect` names an extra effect recipe in src/systems/itemFx.js. Items not listed only pop their icon (their hits already show the normal hit of their damage type). Projectile looks (bomb, lightning, greenfire) and thorns / lifesteal / tornado are drawn from their own events. iconPop: size and timing of the icon pop. noPop: true = this item does NOT pop its icon or play the proc sound (user: frequent simple procs: Quiver of Plenty, Metronome; and the debuff procs, whose status icon already shows: Venom Fang, Ember Charm, Rusty Nails, Hex Doll, Serrated Edge, Dread Bell, Thousand Cuts, Provoker's Horn).

iconPop._stack: Many pops at once over one hero (BattleScene.iconPop): count = same item bumps its icon + xN, bounce = same without the number, queue = one at a time (queueMax waiting, each queueMsShare of ms while others wait), row = all side by side (old). maxSide = most different items side by side.
iconPop._deck: stack 'deck' (user, session 26: queue but like stacking cards): each icon dealt onto one pile deckGapMs after the last, deckStepPx up/right of it, at most deckMax cards; each card fades on its own like a normal pop (user).
